title: The BMS Digital Library: a home for the movement's documents
author: Editorial Desk
summary: Books, resolutions, notices and photographs are being gathered in one searchable repository.
body:
A movement of seventy years leaves behind paper: conference reports, resolutions, memoranda, newsletters, books and photographs. Much of it is in boxes, in private collections or on unconnected websites.

## The Digital Library

BMS has set up a **Digital Library** on its .org domain, at *repository.bharatiyamazdoorsangh.org*, to gather such material in one place. The aim is to let karyakartas, researchers and students **find and read** documents without having to know where they are kept.

## How it relates to this website

- This portal, **bharatiyamazdoorsangh.com**, is the public face: news, leadership, press, gallery, blog and downloads.
- The **Digital Library** is the archive: documents and publications with metadata.

## How you can help

- Send scans of **old notices, books and circulars** to the web team.
- Identify **people and dates** in old photographs.
- Suggest **categories** that make browsing easier.

## Why archives matter

Organisations that remember do better than those that start from scratch each year. A library lets later generations learn from earlier ones.
